title: Autumn Equinox Morning Retreat
location: The Glebe Centre, Vicarage Rd, Crawley Down, Crawley RH10 4JJ, UK
description:
Join me for a nourishing morning retreat devoted to movement, meditation, sacred sound and deep relaxation. 
We will begin with Kundalini Yoga to awaken the body, open the breath and prepare the nervous system for meditation.
Together, we will then journey through an extended Kirtan Kriya Meditation, using the mantra Sa Ta Na Ma with sound, rhythm, mudra and focus. This beautiful practice reflects the natural cycle of life—birth, life, transformation and renewal—and supports us in moving with greater balance, clarity and flow.
We will complete our morning with a deeply restorative Gong Bath, allowing the vibrations of the gongs to release tension, quieten the mind and gently integrate the experience.
